title: Yoga Instructor Takes Control
description:
Yoga class can be a really enlightening, spiritual experience, and this yoga class will open your mind to some interesting new ideas about self-massage, and surrendering oneself to a higher power... your instructor.

A hot, naughty roleplay that has you stroking to my command, and slowly giving in to my powers of persuasion as I reveal the real nature of our 1-1 yoga session.

CW: Findom elements, but they are part of the roleplay, and no actual findom is expected.
